commands.review_summary:
The PR delays direct and mapped agent-hook success until isolated-run admission, maps pre-start failures to HTTP errors, coalesces pending idempotent dispatches, and aborts admissions after 15 seconds.

PR surface: Source +124, Tests +221. Total +345 across 4 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level with high confidence. Current main acknowledges the hook before isolated-run admission, and this branch can time out while asynchronous preparation still precedes final runner entry.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The remaining code blocker is a narrow lifecycle guard and regression-test repair suitable for automation; live contributor or maintainer proof remains an independent merge gate.

target.title: fix(hooks): report agent startup admission failures
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`/hooks/agent` could return HTTP success as soon as an isolated agent run was queued, even if the run failed before reaching runner-entry/session admission. For Symphony Kanban this made a hook dispatch look durable while the worker had actually hit a lifecycle/startup failure such as:

`Session "agent:herbert-karajan:hook:symphony-kanban" changed while starting work. Retry.`

That left the board with an accepted dispatch but no reliable worker closeout path.

This PR changes agent hook dispatch so startup/admission failures surface through the HTTP response before the idempotency key is cached:

- waits for `onExecutionStarted` before returning `{ ok: true, runId }`
- returns `409` for changed/deleted/archived session startup failures
- returns `503` if runner entry does not start before the admission timeout
- returns `502` for other pre-start failures
- keeps post-start failures on the existing async/log/system-event path
- preserves hook session-key policy and `deliver:false` behavior

## Evidence

- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/gateway/hooks.test.ts src/gateway/hooks-mapping.test.ts src/gateway/server.hooks.test.ts src/gateway/server-http.hooks-request-timeout.test.ts src/gateway/server/hooks.agent-trust.test.ts`
  - passed: 16 files / 314 tests
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
  - passed
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
  - passed

## Operational Boundary

This is source-only. It does not restart or modify any live gateway config by itself. Runtime activation still requires the normal deployment path and an approved gateway refresh.

## Related Tracking

- KAN-278: implementation card for the hook-session routing/admission fix.
- KAN-223: live worker smoke target after merge/deploy/gateway refresh.
- KAN-267: superseded duplicate investigation card.
